reasons.plausibility: Using a reactive Ti coating to improve W–Cu interfacial bonding and suppress void formation is scientifically sound, aligning well with known diffusion-barrier and interfacial stabilization mechanisms.
reasons.testability: Comparing coated vs. uncoated composites under identical service conditions with microstructural and thermal analyses provides a clear, decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly targets a critical challenge for W–Cu joints in high-temperature and irradiation environments and suggests a practical, potentially impactful intervention.
